mcp_draft04_boolean_exclusive_bounds.interpretation: Claude Code does not rewrite the schema when a custom base URL is set, and Haiku 4.5 accepted it. This does NOT establish that every model accepts it, so a compat rewrite is not currently required but is not disproven for other targets.
